title: Charred Portuguese Cabbage Bowl
description: A hearty, flavorful vegan bowl featuring roasted cabbage and a tangy sauce, inspired by the bold flavors of Portugal.
instructions: Cut the cabbage into wedges and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, oregano, and five-spice powder.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and caramelized.
In a separate pan, heat the vegan broth over medium heat.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until slightly reduced.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the roasted cabbage on a plate, followed by a ladle of the tangy sauce.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
